name: Abusive Parents
overview: Scripture acknowledges the pain caused when parents fail in their role, as seen in Psalms where even if father and mother forsake a child, the Lord faithfully gathers and cares for them. God draws near to those with broken and contrite hearts, offering comfort and salvation. Fathers are specifically admonished in Ephesians and Colossians not to provoke their children to anger or discouragement, but instead to nurture and instruct them with gentleness. Proverbs highlights the power of a soft answer to defuse wrath, contrasting it with harsh words that escalate anger, underscoring the importance of loving, patient parenting.
